## deploy/release-notes-8.15.4-7744.md
1 # Release notes: profile-svc build 8.15.4-7744
2 
3 Previous build: 8.14.8. Defaults below override repository config files.
4 
5 - batching: max batch size default 200 (unchanged)
6 - build: container base image refreshed
7 - config: `log.level` default remains info
8 - scheduler: cron jitter added to cleanup job
9 - retry: idempotent GETs retried once on connect errors
10 - logging: structured request ids added to access logs
11 - clients: default `clients.ledger-api.timeout_ms` lowered from 2500 to 600 (fail fast)
12 - api: `/v1/status` returns build id
13 - security: TLS session tickets rotated hourly
14 - deps: json serializer upgraded
15 - metrics: new histogram for cache hit latency
16 - deps: http client library upgraded to a patch release
17 - db: default connection pool `db.pool.max_size` lowered from 48 to 14 to fit the shared-db connection quota
18 - tracing: sampling rate default 1% (unchanged)
19 - feature flags: `ff-legacy-export` removed (was 0%)
## ops/oncall-notes.md
1 # On-call notes - profile-svc incident 2031-06-06
2 
3 Informal running notes. Not reviewed; may be out of date.
4 
5 - 08:28 api-gateway 5xx for profile-svc since build 8.15.4-7744 rolled out. Many ledger-api timeouts.
6 - 08:38 Suspect the ledger-api timeout default change in 8.15.4-7744; asking for a mitigation.
